items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: He would have been with Duke. I don't know how Duke came about getting all great men like Jimmy Blanton, Otto Hardwick (unintelligible), Johnny Hodges, even Sonny Greer.

ctx.x: Loved him. Beautiful, wonderful. He's a Big professional im there, now Oh, yeah, Jimmy
Blanton. He would have been with Duke. I don't know how Duke came about getting all great men like Jimmy Blanton, Otto Hardwick (unintelligible), Johnny Hodges, even Sonny Greer.
